headline: Who's in My Class at UCSB? How to See Classmates Early
description: GOLD won't show you who's in your UCSB classes. How students actually find classmates before week one — group chats, Discords, and Lagoon's classmate discovery.

mainEntity.name: Can you see who's in your class on GOLD?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. GOLD shows your own schedule and enrollment counts, but never which students are in a class. Rosters are only visible to instructors.

mainEntity.name: How can I see which friends are in my UCSB classes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lagoon shows which of your friends share each of your classes automatically after you import your schedule, plus an anonymous count of how many Gauchos total are in each section.

mainEntity.name: Does Lagoon show my name to strangers in my classes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only mutual friends see each other by name. Everyone else only ever appears in anonymous counts.
